full_name: Steffani Jemison | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2017–2018 Arts Mildred Londa Weisman Fellow Rutgers University
bio: Steffani Jemison is a visual artist and educator. Her recent work approaches privacy and opacity as strategies of abstraction and strategies of political resistance.
